question: Which Photoshop desktop version number did Adobe release on November 10, 2026, alongside Adobe MAX 2026?
answer: Photoshop version 28.0 is listed as the November 2026 release, and the release notes page was last updated on November 10, 2026 [1]. The release notes list it as the November 2026 release [1], and Adobe's community announcement for the MAX 2026 release says that users with auto-updates on might already have version 28.0 [3]. The supported-versions page also names 28.x as the current version [5]. One security bulletin refers to the same release as "Photoshop 2027 version 28.0" [7].

keyPoints.text: The November 2026 Photoshop desktop release is version 28.0, per the release notes dated November 10, 2026.

Adobe's security bulletin references Photoshop 2027 version 28.0 as the update target.
Adobe MAX 2026 coverage describes Relight as a new Photoshop desktop generative AI feature.
